official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Playbook is a media backend for creative teams. This plugin connects your Playbook workspace so you can search images, video and documents by keyword or by what they show, organize them into folders, tag them and fill in custom fields, upload files from a URL, Google Drive or Dropbox, review version history, read the text of PDFs, and share a folder through a link, a published page or an email invitation. It acts as the signed-in Playbook user and reaches only the workspaces that account belongs to. It does not download file contents, read text inside images or scanned PDFs, or extract video captions.

limitations_ja: ログイン中の利用者が所属するワークスペースが対象。画像やスキャンPDF内の文字、動画字幕は読み取らないと説明。内包アプリ欄はboardsと記載し、本文ではfoldersと記載。
